schema.content:
Table "Categories" {
  "CategoryID" INTEGER [pk]
  "CategoryName" TEXT
  "Description" TEXT
}

Table "Customers" {
  "CustomerID" INTEGER [pk]
  "CustomerName" TEXT
  "ContactName" TEXT
  "Address" TEXT
  "City" TEXT
  "PostalCode" TEXT
  "Country" TEXT
}

Table "Employees" {
  "EmployeeID" INTEGER [pk]
  "LastName" TEXT
  "FirstName" TEXT
  "BirthDate" DATE
  "Photo" TEXT
  "Notes" TEXT
}

Table "OrderDetails" {
  "OrderDetailID" INTEGER [pk]
  "OrderID" INTEGER
  "ProductID" INTEGER
  "Quantity" INTEGER
}

Table "Orders" {
  "OrderID" INTEGER [pk]
  "CustomerID" INTEGER
  "EmployeeID" INTEGER
  "OrderDate" TIMESTAMP
  "ShipperID" INTEGER
}

Table "Products" {
  "ProductID" INTEGER [pk]
  "ProductName" TEXT
  "SupplierID" INTEGER
  "CategoryID" INTEGER
  "Unit" TEXT
  "Price" REAL
}

Table "Shippers" {
  "ShipperID" INTEGER [pk]
  "ShipperName" TEXT
  "Phone" TEXT
}

Table "Suppliers" {
  "SupplierID" INTEGER [pk]
  "SupplierName" TEXT
  "ContactName" TEXT
  "Address" TEXT
  "City" TEXT
  "PostalCode" TEXT
  "Country" TEXT
  "Phone" TEXT
}



Ref: "Products"."SupplierID" > "Suppliers"."SupplierID"

Ref: "Products"."CategoryID" > "Categories"."CategoryID"

Ref: "Orders"."ShipperID" > "Shippers"."ShipperID"

Ref: "Orders"."CustomerID" > "Customers"."CustomerID"

Ref: "Orders"."EmployeeID" > "Employees"."EmployeeID"

Ref: "OrderDetails"."ProductID" > "Products"."ProductID"

Ref: "OrderDetails"."OrderID" > "Orders"."OrderID"
